claims.text: The hotel was built in 2001 and operated for many years as a St. Regis resort.

findings.quote: Built in 2001 atop the Monarch Bay, this hotel operated for many years as a St. Regis resort.

claims.text: In early 2021 the resort joined the Waldorf Astoria Collection.

findings.quote: In early 2021, after a few years as an independent hotel, the Monarch Beach Resort joined the Waldorf Astoria Collection

claims.text: Monarch Bay Beach Club has an indoor-outdoor bar and offers sunset dinners on the Beach Lawn.

claims.text: AVEO Table + Bar has a rotating seasonal menu with ingredients predominantly grown or caught in Southern California.

findings.quote: A rotating seasonal menu showcases local seafood, prime filets, savory sandwiches, and fresh salads, with ingredients predominantly grown or caught in Southern California.
